## About These Links

Clicking a link may download a `.kyyrule` file directly; it does not promise one-click app installation. You can also use "Download this version" and import the file manually.

- "Import link" points to the package with the same rule ID in the latest Release, for saving or sharing. It does not guarantee automatic updates after installation.
- "Download this version" is pinned to this directory snapshot. Collection manifests retain version-pinned URLs, sizes, and SHA-256 values; integrity checks do not rely on `latest`.
- A stable import link may stop working when a source is removed from the latest Release. Historical packages do not imply continued maintenance or availability.
- Names and ratings come from the published collection. They do not imply website availability, content authorization, or review, endorsement, or guarantees by any app.

This directory links only to optional, community-maintained encrypted rule packages. It hosts no manga or video content and contains no plaintext rules or keys.
It is generated from published collection manifests. For feedback or removal requests, use the repository Issues and include the rule ID.
